notes.title: November 13, 2024　Difficulty Adjustments
notes.content:
・Added a memo sheet above the buttons summarizing the next floors to proceed to.
・Introduced a checkpoint that activates after more than half of the attempts, excluding the first four tries.
・Modified button functionality so that, except when starting from the ground floor, only the button for the next required floor can be pressed.
・Adjusted the difficulty levels of enemies.
The conditions for the True Ending have been relaxed.

notes.title: 2024/05/06 Fixed a bug that could lock the door in the red room.
notes.content: Fixed a bug that could lock the door in the red room.

notes.title: 2024/04/06 Reduced time to auto-close, changed default zoom key to mouse right
notes.content:
・Reduced the time until it closes automatically (from 20 s to 5 s).
　(Please hold down to observe the floor.)

・Changed the default zoom key to right mouse drag.
　It is automatically changed for those who have set it as the control key in the key configurations.

notes.title: 2024/04/05 Added key configurations, added stage direction when clearing stages
notes.content:
Added key configurations.
It can be changed from the options screen.

Added stage direction when clearing a stage.

notes.title: 2024/04/04 Allowing the player to hold the door open.
notes.content: The player can now hold down the Shift key to hold the door open.
